privacy:
In this policy, the words "we," "our," and "us" refers to Certification Planner. The procedures mentioned in this section apply to all the personnel and users who access this website. Certification Planner takes the privacy of our participants very seriously and is keen to protect their privacy rights. With CP's website, we ensure your information is secure.

Our Information Practices

We have considered the accuracy of our website; however, the content on the website is subject to change. We won't be responsible for any damage from the use of the information stored on the server.

All our training materials are virus free; however, Certification Planner is not liable for damages from virus infection.

Use of Information Stored by Certification Planner

  • Our users have complete control over the privacy of their information.
  • Certification Planner will never disclose, sell or exchange users' information to any third party for promotions or other purposes.
  • Users are free to opt or decline to receive offers from Certification Planner.

We do not collect and store users' details from any medium; we only store the details you willingly shared with us. We may use the contact information you shared to get feedback and support or to give information about new courses. You can unsubscribe if you don't want to receive newsletters/emails from Certification Planner. While enrolling for in-person or online classroom training, you may need to make an online payment. You must provide your personal information like name, email, phone number, credit card details, and address(s). We don't store your credit card details in our system using Secure Encryption Technology (SSL).

Course Material

All course materials are designed for training and education purposes, and we keep updating our course material regularly. Certification Planner reserves the right to modify the content without any prior notice.

Update Personal Details

If we have any false information about you, we request you contact us to correct that information.

Deleting Information

To delete your account with Certification Planner, drop an email at support@certificationplanner.com.

Updating Privacy Policy

Certification Planner reserves all rights to modify the policy without prior notice.

Guaranteed to Run Bootcamp

Certification Planner tries in best in our capacity to run all our training workshops. However, the Certification Planner reserves the right to postpone, cancel the training or change the location in various circumstances like insufficient enrollments, instructor unavailability due to health issues, or other force majeure events like earthquakes, floods, political instability, etc.

During the current COVID-19 crisis, the "Guaranteed to Run Bootcamp" is limited by:

i. The government's restriction to conduct in-person classroom training in any state or area

ii. Lockdowns initiated by the government or other concerned bodies

iii. Virus infection to the instructor or any participant

We value your safety, and in-person classroom training may be rescheduled or canceled under any of the above conditions. If an in-person classroom is canceled because of any of the reasons mentioned above, the participant may choose to:

1. Reschedule the training for future available dates.

2. Switch to other available training models with a balance refund

3. Receive a Credit Voucher with one-year validity.

Use of Credit voucher

  • * The credit voucher will be valid for one year, and the participant can use the credit voucher to enroll in future training.
  • * The credit voucher can be used for any course having the same value as the credit voucher.
  • * The credit voucher can be used to select multiple courses/training models, given the total cost does not exceed the value of the Credit Voucher.
  • * The credit voucher can be used only once.
  • * If the participant uses the credit voucher for future in-person or training, he or she will have current from the existing training dates.
  • * The Credit Voucher can be transferred to another participant.
  • * The participant will have to give a one-week notice before the use of the credit voucher in case of in-person and live online training

Mandatory Safety Measures in Classroom

Safety measures mandate the use of safety masks by participants and instructors, at all times, within the training premise and during the training. In the interest of public safety, violation of safety measures will directly lead to expulsion from the said training. If a participant exhibits any sythey COVID-19, he or she should report the same to the training center, the support team, and the local authorities.   

CP will provide necessary guidance to all the delegates and support the training center in conducting the training in a safe and healthy environment. However, participants are responsible for attending the in-person classroom training. The training provider, the training center, the instructor, or other participants will not be held accountable for the exposure to or infection by the Coronavirus.

100% Pass Guarantee 

Certification Planner tries, to the best of its capacity, to assist you to succeed in the certification exam by providing you with course-related preparation material and training. If you do not clear the certification exam, we have a 100% Money Back Guarantee in Place. Please refer to the refund section to learn about the 100% Money Back Guarantee.
refund:
Refund Policy for Certification Planner, LLC:

  1. Cancellation Right After Enrollment to 2 Weeks Before Class Start Date:

    • Cancellations made within this timeframe will incur a mandatory administration charge of 10% of the enrollment fee.
    • The remaining amount will be refunded to the attendee.

  2. Cancellation Within 2 Weeks of Class Start Date:

    • No refunds will be processed for cancellations made within two weeks of the class start date.

  3. Exceptions:

    • In cases of family emergencies or health crises like COVID-19, special arrangements may be made for rescheduling the class to virtual or in-person based on management approval.
    • Such requests must be supported by appropriate documentation or evidence.

  4. Process:

    • To initiate a refund request, attendees must contact Certification Planner, LLC, via email or phone, providing details of their cancellation.
    • Refund requests will be reviewed and processed within 30 Days..

  5. Administration Charges:

    • The administration charges are non-negotiable and apply to all refund requests falling within the specified timeframe.

  6. Management Approval:

    • Any exceptions to the refund policy, including special arrangements for family emergencies or health crises, require approval from the management team.

  7. Communication:

    • Attendees will be promptly notified of the status of their refund request via email or chat.

This refund policy is subject to change at the discretion of Certification Planner, LLC, without prior notice.

Please direct any inquiries regarding refunds or cancellations to support@certificationplanner.com

faqs.a: Yes, CP offer an amazing incentives program for all our business partners. Reach out to us on email or call to learn more

faqs.q: How many instructors does CP has?
faqs.a: We have a network of over 5000+ instructors from across the globe. All our instructors are certified and hold 10+ years of experience.

faqs.q: Do you offer corporate training for a large group?
faqs.a: Yes, CP offers a customized training options to our clients with minimum of 5 attendees to maximum of 200 attendees in a class.
We are based out of Salt Lake City, UT. However we have training locations across the globe and offer our trainings in USA, Canada, Mexico, Australia, UK, Europe, Middle East and Southeast Asia
